content:
Sophia R: noticing a spike of 5xx on production embeddings + small text gen in eu-west around 09:07 UTC. customers report elevated latency and errors. example request ids: rQ4f2, rQ4f7.
Ana (infra): looking now, seeing consistent KV cache checksum mismatches across two nodes in eu-west-1 cache cluster. errors started ~09:05 UTC.
Liam (runtime): any recent config pushes to cache layer?
Deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-23T08:58 by liam-runtime to service kv-cache-config (version v2.14) completed 09:00 UTC.
Ana (infra): that aligns. suspect cross-region replication produced stale entries after a metadata race.
Sophia R: customer-impacting? severity?
Ana (infra): yes — embeddings pipeline retries hit 5xx after failing to validate cached prefixes. fallback to cold path is causing overload on primary model pods -> some 503s. marking P2-High for now.
Liam (runtime): mitigation plan: 1) disable cross-region cache replication (quick toggle), 2) force eviction of suspect keys in eu-west cluster, 3) temporarily route embeddings reads to fallback read-only mirror in eu-central.
Ana (infra): executing step 1 now. toggling replication flag -> done.
Ana (infra): initiating targeted eviction for keys with checksum mismatch. running eviction script: 
```
#!/bin/bash
for id in $(cat bad_keys.txt); do
  redis-cli -h eu-west-cache del "$id"
done
```
Ana (infra): eviction in progress, tracking progress, ETA ~ 4 min.
Deploy-bot: config toggle noted in audit log: actors: ana-infra, liam-runtime.
Pagerduty-bot: triggered incident pgrp-781 (oncall: ana-infra).
Liam (runtime): routing rule applied to send embeddings read traffic to eu-central mirror. monitoring token-level error rate.
Emily (cs): pinging top affected customers with a brief note and link to status.
Sophia R: status update to customers/staff? suggest short bulletin: what happened, mitigation, ETA, next steps.
Ana (infra): current status: errors reduced by ~78% after eviction + routing. still seeing residual 5xx for <1% of requests as cache warms.
Liam (runtime): metrics: 5xx rate from 12% -> 2.6% in last 5 min, p95 latency reduced from 870ms -> 230ms.
Emily (cs): posted customer note on shared thread and slack #customer-updates, added link to status page.
Sophia R: record for postmortem: root cause suspected race in cross-region replication metadata handling introduced in v2.14. next steps: full postmortem, fix in replication handshake, add preflight checksum warnings to canary gate.
Ana (infra): runbook & post-incident actions: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-replication-failure and status: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1780456789.
Liam (runtime): creating follow-up ticket for code fix + enhanced canary tests. assigning to runtime team.
Sophia R: thanks everyone. please add any logs or timelines to the incident doc. will schedule 1-hour blameless review tomorrow 15:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
